id.description: The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event.

ts.description: When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced.

workspace_id.description: A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID.

space_id.description: The space, when the event belongs to one.

run_id.description: The run, when the event belongs to one.

seq.description: Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in.

idempotency_key.description: Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op.

kind.description: Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted.

id.description: The participant id, or `system` for Chips.

harness_id.description: For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips.

actor.description: The participant an event is attributed to.

participant_kind.description: A person or an agent (ADR 0087); `harness` for a harness in a room before the upgrade gave it an agent.

role.description: Their standing here, which is what every `from` field reports.

joined_at.description: Defaults to the event's own timestamp.

moved_from.description: For an agent moved here from another room (ADR 0087): the room it left. Written by Chips.

fork_of.description: For a fork's copy (ADR 0087, Fork): the `agent.fork` it answers, so the room shows the copy joining on the line that asked for it. Written by Chips.

made_for.description: For a new agent a person asked a harness for (ADR 0108): the `agent.asked` it answers, so the room shows it joining on the line that asked for it. Written by Chips.

agent_name.description: For a harness asked for this room from the + (ADR 0150): the first name its agent will have here, held for it until it claims the room or answers in it, and the name the room calls it by meanwhile. A person's device may propose one; Chips keeps it when nobody has it and picks one off its list otherwise.

invite_id.description: For a person who came in by a space's invite link (ADR 0168): the link, so the room says they joined by it. The actor is whoever made the link, who put them here. Written by Chips.

description: A person or an agent joined a space. Shows as a muted centred line.
title: MembershipAdded
